chapterTitle: Chapter 16 Chemistry of Benzene: Electrophilic Aromatic Substitution
title: Problem 16-20

pages.text: PROBLEM 16-20 Styrene, the simplest alkenylbenzene, is prepared commercially for use in plastics manufacture by catalytic dehydrogenation of ethylbenzene. How might you prepare styrene from benzene using reactions you’ve studied?
